name: The Stifftones
text:
About 2 years ago, I was starting a new project and needed help. Martin responded to me in an online diy forum. Since that day, he has been invaluable. I talk to Martin on a regular basis, almost weekly. I regularly seek out his expertise on many different projects. He is smart, kind, patient, aggressive, and encouraging. He will put in as much as you do. Helping people grow their ideas and challenge themselves to set and reach their goals is his passion. I have never even had the pleasure of meeting Martin in person. That has not impeded our working relationship. He is very present and available even from a distance.  I highly recommend Martin Gawlak Company. Do it, you won't be disappointed and you'll have a new friend.
-Rachel Stief
Co-Founder The Stifftones, Co-Founder Stiff Competition LLC., Crypto investor, Registered Nurse

name: Donna Pulito
text: Martin is genuinely in the business of simply helping people. He is there for you at any time no matter how big or how small your need. He is a rare gem in this industry. I cannot recommend him enough.
